19.en: The cards shown are placed into two boxes. 2 3 4 5 6 The sums of the numbers in each box are the same. Which number must be in the box with the number 4? Solution: The sum of all of the numbers is 20, so the sum of the numbers in each box is 10. The only way we can make 10 in the blue box is by having 4 and 6 (no other combinations work), so our answer is only 6.
